title: Curvature-Aware Edge Dynamic GNNs for Low-$p_T$ Track Reconstruction at HL-LHC
abstract: arXiv:2611.17343v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Particle track reconstruction in high-energy collider experiments is a computationally demanding combinatorial problem, traditionally solved by Kalman filters that scale poorly with increasing detector occupancy. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently emerged as a promising alternative. In this work, we introduce the Manifold Helical-IN, a novel Interaction Network architecture that explicitly embeds detector spacepoints onto a helical manifold chart using curvature-aware features. This geometric projection mathematically unrolls the tightly curling trajectories of low-momentum particles. Consequently, the network can distinguish true physical tracks from combinatorial noise with good precision. Evaluated on the TrackML challenge dataset, the proposed Manifold Helical-IN achieves a reconstruction efficiency of 0.9675 in the experimentally critical $p_T > 0.5$ GeV regime, approaching recently reported Transformer-based approaches. translated_title: 面向HL-LHC低$p_T$径迹重建的曲率感知边缘动态图神经网络
translated_abstract: 高能对撞机实验中的粒子径迹重建是一个计算量巨大的组合问题，传统上采用卡尔曼滤波器求解，但随着探测器占据率的增加，其扩展性能较差。图神经网络（GNN）近年来作为一种有前景的替代方案而兴起。在这项工作中，我们提出了流形螺旋网络（Manifold Helical-IN），这是一种新颖的交互网络架构，它利用曲率感知特征将探测器空间点显式地嵌入到螺旋流形图册上。这种几何投影在数学上“展开”了低动量粒子紧密卷曲的轨迹，从而使网络能够以良好的精度区分真实的物理径迹与组合噪声。在TrackML挑战赛数据集上的评估表明，所提出的流形螺旋网络在实验上至关重要的 $p_T > 0.5$ GeV 区域实现了0.9675的重建效率，接近近期报道的基于Transformer的方法。
tldr: 提出曲率感知的流形螺旋交互网络（Manifold Helical-IN），通过将探测器空间点嵌入螺旋流形来“展开”低动量粒子的卷曲轨迹，在TrackML数据集的 $p_T > 0.5$ GeV 关键区域实现了0.9675的高径迹重建效率。
en_tdlr: The Manifold Helical-IN, a curvature-aware Interaction Network that embeds detector spacepoints onto a helical manifold to unroll tightly curled low-momentum particle trajectories, achieves 0.9675 track reconstruction efficiency in the critical $p_T > 0.5$ GeV regime on the TrackML dataset.
